phase: migration of layout from its crate-local page/frame/thread model to Folio pages, text frames, threads and StudioTextStory

commits.subject: Layout: page/spread geometry, text frames, threaded reflow with overset, first-fit and Knuth-Plass breakers (compiles, clippy clean)
Layout: 5 hand-computed focused tests, layout-consumer example, Knuth-Plass boundary tolerance, -0 sum normalisation

Layout: consume Folio pages, text frames, threads and StudioTextStory; delete the crate-local Page/Spread/TextFrame model (reflow, breakers and overset unchanged; 5 oracle tests keep their values, +1 Folio-input test)

capabilities_done: Migration (64dd62d): public Margins/Page/Spread/TextFrame and the index-based thread are deleted; ReflowRequest now carries document: &StudioDocument (its revision is the current revision; expected_revision stays), story: &StudioTextStory, resolved_text: Option<&str> (stored content only, exactly byte_len bytes), paragraphs (Type-shaped, unchanged), obstacles: &[FrameObstacles], composer, space, expected_revision, limits

src/folio_input.rs (new): resolves one story's thread from Folio: the layers whose Payload::Text names the story and that carry text_frame, walked with StudioDocument::text_threads(); pages and spreads located with locate_page (spread_index, page_index); frame origin in spread coordinates = sum of preceding page widths in the spread + frame bounds; all numbers re-checked (finite, unit pt, positive sizes, four-sided inset, first baseline from minimum_first_baseline_offset inside the top inset) because the document is not assumed validated
Four-sided Folio inset_spacing replaces the scalar inset (left/right bound the line slot, bottom bounds the frame fit, top bounds the first baseline); uniform insets give the old behaviour

Typed refusals kept and remapped: CyclicThread (links loop, with or without a first frame), InvalidInput (missing link or page, a second chain for the story, no frame for the story, shaped paragraph past the story end, stored content without or with wrong-length resolved_text, text_kind point or path), InvalidGeometry (non-finite, non-pt, non-positive, inset or page degenerate, bad obstacle rect), StaleRevision against document.revision; new UnsupportedComposition cases for what Folio can say but this slice does not compose: right-to-left story or paragraph direction, frame_grid story, text_column_count != 1, vertical_justification != top, auto_sizing_type != off, first_baseline_offset != fixed

FramePlacement.frame_id is the Folio layer_id and frame_index the layer's index in StudioDocument::layers; FrameObstacles{frame_id, rects} carries text-wrap rectangles per frame layer (Folio stores none); geometry.rs keeps only Rect

Unchanged by design: breaker.rs (FirstFit, Knuth-Plass), paragraph.rs, the reflow/slot/overset algorithm, report(), SourceSpan, LayoutError; DESCRIPTOR and the layout-consumer example now build and flow a Folio document (one page, a frame chain, one story)
Cargo.toml: hsk-studio-folio path dependency added (allowed by workspace.metadata.studio.dependencies for layout); layout is a leaf (no crate depends on it)
next: Independent validator round on 64dd62d for crates/hsk-studio-layout (supersedes the round on 259ea44): tests/threaded_reflow first (the 5 original oracle tests keep their expected values; the 6th, folio_inputs_select_the_story_thread_and_unsupported_properties_are_refused, is new). Later scope: nib WrapProvider contour wrap, columns, justification/hyphenation, first_baseline_offset ascent/leading from the paragraph metrics, a real Type end-to-end test through from_type.

validation_evidence.layout_tests: PASS 6/6 on the tree equal to pushed 64dd62d; the five original tests (two_frame_flow_overset, obstacle_wrap_and_overfull_word, knuth_plass_hand_computed_and_deterministic, cyclic_missing_font_budget_cancel_stale_unsupported, break_opportunities_forced_breaks_and_report) assert the same line, span, width, hang, ratio, origin and overset values as before; only fixtures changed (Folio types) and the refusal cases were re-expressed on Folio links, fields and revision
validation_evidence.clippy: PASS no layout warnings (clippy -p hsk-studio-layout --tests --examples; the type crate emits its own pre-existing warnings)
validation_evidence.example: layout-consumer --text 'aaaa bbbb cccc dddd eeee' --frame 60x12 --frame 60x12 prints two single-line frames and overset [20,24] with Folio layer ids
validation_evidence.fixture_validity: the new test validates its fixture with hsk_studio_folio::validate_document, so the fixture is a real Folio document
validation_evidence.rustfmt: only the new folio_input.rs is rustfmt clean; the existing layout files were not rustfmt clean before and were not reformatted
validation_evidence.not_proven: No Type-shaped paragraph is run end to end (from_type still compile-checked only); no InDesign oracle; right-to-left, CJK and the unsupported frame properties are refused, never laid out; the shaped paragraphs are not cross-checked against the story's paragraph partition (only that they end inside the story); applied_language and style_ref are not consumed (no hyphenation or style resolution in layout yet)

migration_decisions: The document is taken as &StudioDocument, not &Snapshot, so layout stays defensive: it keeps its own typed refusals (CyclicThread, InvalidGeometry, InvalidInput) for hand-built or unvalidated input instead of trusting that Folio validation ran; Folio's validate_document refuses the same inputs earlier (ThreadCycle, InvalidThread, InvalidUnit)
The thread is selected by story id (StudioTextStory.story_id) from the frame layers of the document, so several stories can live in one document and be reflowed independently
A private resolved Frame (numbers only, borrowed from the document, rebuilt on every call) feeds the unchanged reflow loops; it is not a model of record and is not exported
Overset stays layout output (LayoutProposal.overset) and is not written into the document (Folio does not store overflows)

Only first_baseline_offset = fixed is composed (the offset is minimum_first_baseline_offset from the frame top, as the old first_baseline_pt); ascent, cap_height, leading, em_box_height and x_height are refused as UnsupportedComposition rather than guessed
Folio inset_spacing is four-sided; the old scalar inset_pt maps to four equal values
FramePlacement.frame_index changed meaning from an index into the request's frame slice to the layer's index in StudioDocument::layers

decisions_for_lead: SourceSpan is layout-local (u64 byte range, From<type::SourceRange>) so layout's public types stay plain for components/interop-layout
Hanging trailing whitespace belongs to the line's glyph range (ranges tile the paragraph exactly) but not to width_pt; hang_pt reports it
Empty paragraph occupies one empty line; no space before/after paragraphs; left-aligned only (no justification/hyphenation/columns) in this slice
Relation of this Knuth-Plass to the Adobe Paragraph Composer is UNVERIFIED (research/adobe-behavior.md)
Brief lists src/threaded_reflow.rs + src/paragraph.rs + tests/threaded_reflow.rs: matched; extra files geometry.rs and breaker.rs added by this slice
capabilities_unchanged: paragraph.rs: LayoutGlyph/ShapedParagraph (from_type flattens a Type ParagraphResult; from_fixed_advance toy fixture), break_opportunities via unicode-linebreak UAX #14, box/glue/penalty items (hanging trailing space, forced breaks, in-word opportunities after hyphen)

breaker.rs: Composer::FirstFit and Composer::KnuthPlass(KnuthPlassParams): badness 100|r|^3 capped 10000, demerits (line_penalty+b)^2 with penalty term, 4 fitness classes + adjacent-class demerits, per-(line,class) candidates, 3 passes (tolerance 200, 10000, overfull allowed), varying per-line widths, fallback to first-fit

threaded_reflow.rs: reflow -> LayoutProposal {base_revision, frames[FramePlacement{lines[Line]}], overset: exact first unplaced byte .. story end}; obstacle-narrowed line slots (widest gap), blocked baselines skipped; deterministic (no hashing)
Typed refusals, DESCRIPTOR, report() -> one Observe terminal outcome, example layout-consumer
